description: Walk-off-and-respawn: character walks along corridor, falls off far end, dual-gate respawn fires, returns to spawn.
geometry: scenario-corridor map — 2x1x8 colored_block_blue platform (voxel cols x={0,4}, z={0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28}); platform world X: 0–4m, Z: 0–16m, top face at world Y=2m

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.z >= 6 and bot.pos.y within 0.3 of settled height (y≈1.5)
keyframes.description: Bot walking on platform, past the midpoint toward the far end

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.z > 15 (far edge reached) AND observer store vel.y <= -4 m/s (position-delta estimate from PositionBroadcaster is strongly negative during free-fall)
keyframes.description: Bot in free-fall after walking off the far end of the corridor; vel.y in observer store is the position-delta estimate, not the internal Rapier accumulator

keyframes.captureCondition: bot.pos.z < 4 and bot.pos.y within 0.3 of settled height (y≈1.5); spawn point is {x:0,y:0,z:0} (KCC resolves upward to y≈1.5)
keyframes.description: Bot settled back at spawn point after dual-gate respawn
